Dialogs.Dialog: Ugh, putting our little hands together before we eat？ What are we, kindergartners？ Every single day...
Huh？ I've been Kobayakawa since the day I was born. What about it？
What are you spacing out for？ You look so dumb.
(Is this... an elementary school classroom？ Oh right, I'm in elementary school.)
Did you watch Volvavin last week？
Huh？ Volvavin... You mean that robot anime？
Yeah, that one. I guess girls don't watch it, huh？
It's not about being a boy or a girl.
Watching robot anime in the fourth grade is way too childish.
Besides, what's with that？ Grouping people into boys and girls is ridiculous to begin with. Do you know what 'gender' is？ 'Gen-der.'
Huh？ Well... um... You wouldn't get it even if I explained it, so never mind. It's a waste of time.
(It looks like a school lunch from the Showa era...)
Why have you been acting so weird this whole time？ It's not like school lunch is anything new.
Right, we eat it every day...
Then why are you leaving them？
I'm not leaving them. ...I'm just not eating them.
？ Doesn't that mean you hate them after all？
No, it doesn't. They. Taste. Bad.
It's totally different. I'm not being picky, I'm a gourmet. It's my 'policy' not to eat bad food.
People who eat anything and everything just have no sense of taste.
Exactly! ...Oh, I know. If it bothers you that much, you can have them.
It's fine, it's fine, don't be shy. Here, before anyone looks...
Hey, Kobayakawa! Are you leaving food on your tray again!?
And trying to get someone else to eat it for you, too!
Come on, I'll stay here with you. Take your time, just eat it all yourself, okay？
(Huh, she's actually pretty cute when she acts her age like this...)
What's with you acting all high and mighty out of nowhere!
(A dream... I wonder if ▲小早川＊▲ was already like that back in grade school.)
The mysterious secret society De-Kishis has suddenly appeared in New Towano Town! With their Pulse of Misfortune, has everyone in town gone unlucky!?
Standing against them is Rinko... yadda yadda♪ It's Happy-Come Rinko Season 2! Bringing good luck again today, Happy-Come Rinkle~♪
What the？ Happy-Come Rinko？ Isn't that what I saw before...
Whoa, awesome! It really is Happy-Come Rinko!
Of course it is! I'm here to bring good luck to everyone♪
...Wait, didn't your personality change a bit？
Uh-huh... Let me explain, okay？ At the end of Season 1, Rinko was baptized by the Happy Breath and had a change of heart! I've graduated from being that gloomy, monotone magical girl I used to be!
Wait—who are you calling a gloomy hack actor!
Tch! That AD over there just... Ah, no, it's nothing. Right, Dad？
That's right, Rinko! Your dad is so moved!
Hello, Dad. Thank you so much for the other day... when you put me through absolute hell.
Did I？ Don't sweat it, boy in front of the TV!
Well, whatever... Anyway, good for you. It looked super low-budget, yet you still got a second season.
Well, yeah？ That's all thanks to my talent, hehe. My pay went up a little, too...
A-anyway! Let me introduce Rinko's Happy Friend, Manaka-chan♪
Heya! Lucky-Lucky Manapyon is on the scene~♪
▲高嶺＊＊▲, you really ought to be pickier about the jobs you take...
Hey, is it okay if I come out soon？
Oh, Nene-senpai. Looking forward to working with you!
What kind of role are you even playing, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲？
I'm Amazo-Nene, commander of the mysterious secret society De-Kissez! Time to vacuuuum up your Happy!
...If you cringe at me, I'll get mad, okay？
W-Whoa! It's Amazo-Nene of De-Kissez! Run away before she sucks up our Happy～!
Come on, that was totally out of nowhere!
Well, beggars can't be choosers. Now, let's get back on track!
Excuse me, letting your phone ring in the middle of a take？ What kind of training does your agency give you？
I've lost all respect for you...
Hello...? Yes... Um, we're right in the middle of filming... Huh!?
You're wrapping up Season 2 early for Season 3, "Hapi-Kamu Three"!? W-Wait a second, what do you mean, "Three"？ Huh, you're coming over here？
Ah, my bad, my bad. The sponsors wanna move more toys, see, so triple the main characters means triple the merch—everybody's rolling in dough, lol.
Three main characters...? Rinko's still the center, right？ And more importantly, what about my pay!?
We're thinking of deciding the center by popular vote—the Hapi-Kamu General Election. And if any side characters take off, a total upset is 100% on the table.
What!? You've gotta be kidding me! Rinko is the undisputed center! And what about my pay!?
Whoops～？ Got a hard out right after this—got a mtg down in Roppongi, so catch ya later!
Rinko, that's showbiz for you! Don't let it beat you!
Ugh... It was supposed to be my very own show...
I need to start campaigning... First, I'll ask Papa to help secure my local base...
Hey there, little boy in front of the TV～？ If you give big sis your vote～... Hehehe▼
Hmm, a total upset... Does that mean a Daruma has a shot too？
Stupid! Stupid! Go fly away! Hapi-Kamu Rinkuru～♪
I wonder if there'll really be a season three...
Official inspection! Resist, and we will cut you down without mercy!
Rinko Kobayakawa, Captain of the Shinsengumi First Unit. Prepare yourself!
Huh... ▲小早川＊▲？ What's with the outfit! And is that a... toy sword？
What are you spacing out for？ Are those two swords at your hip just for show!?
Storming in with just the two of you？ Laughable! We'll cut you down where you stand!
To think this many lawless ronin were hiding in the Ikedaya. Still, we must hold out until the Commander arrives!
Master Kobayakawa! At this rate, they'll wipe us out. We should fall back for now.
...Then save yourself. I'll carve a path through them.
Don't talk nonsense! You and ● are partners—wherever we go, we go together.
But... at this rate, both of us will...
Even in death, we're together. We swore an oath! How could I leave you behind, Master!?
I won't let you die in a place like this! Together, we'll break through their lines!
What, there's still one left!? Master!
Master! The wound is shallow—stay with me!
...Sorry, looks like I can't keep my promise. So... at least you have to get... away...
▲小早川＊▲! Don't die! I'll never forgive you if you die and leave ● behind...
Heh heh, your face is getting so far away...
This blood... isn't it kind of thin？ And what's this smell...
...What are you talking about？ Obviously it's just fake blood.
Fake blood？ Wait... isn't this tomato juice？
I looked around for something I could use as fake blood, but couldn't find anything. And then there happened to be tomato juice on the table.
Happened to be... Whoa, the smell of tomato juice is really strong...
What's wrong？ You look really pale.
I totally forgot how much I hate tomatoes... How stupid is that.
Ugh... I'm blacking out... Well, I'll leave the rest to you. Good luck.
Hold on! If you're gonna pass out, wait till we break through this ambush... Ha, hahaha.
Uh... Looking at the situation... I don't suppose you'll let us go？
▲小早川＊▲! Wake up already!! There's no way I can take all these guys on by myself!
Gasp... Just a dream. Still, ▲小早川＊▲... kind of suited an outfit like that.
(Slide across the screen to slash the enemies with this sword!)
Slide across the screen to slash the enemies.
It's me, Thumbelina. Don't you remember me, Mr. Swallow？
Oh, sorry, sorry. ...Still, ▲小早川＊▲, you've gotten all tiny again.
(Oops, is she gonna get mad at me for calling her tiny？)
▲小早川＊▲... Are you crying？ What's wrong？
The truth is, I'm being forced to marry Mr. Mole.
Mr. Mole lives in the underground world. If I marry him, I'll have to live underground without the sun too... *sob*...
(▲小早川＊▲'s acting all pure and delicate, unlike usual... This side of her might be kinda cute too.)
All right, got it! ● can handle this!
Thank you so much, Mr. Swallow!
What's with the 'whoa'？ I've got plenty of money, and love too.
Hehehe. I love you, Thumbelina~, I really love you~.
Ms. Mouse already gave our marriage her blessing, y'know？ All that's left is your answer~.
You can see Thumbelina doesn't want this, right？ Stop forcing yourself on her.
Thumbelina's just nervous about living underground 'cause she's never done it before. She'll get used to it in no time.
No, Thumbelina. You can't lose heart!
Stay out of this. What, you think you can make Thumbelina happy？ You got money？ Money～？
Well... ● am still in high school...
Then I sure can't hand Thumbelina over to you, now can I～？ No way～.
▲小早川＊▲. Can you believe in who ● am？
I may not be much of a boyfriend, but do you still believe in me？
Even without money or status, ● love ▲小早川＊▲ more than anyone! And ● can make ▲小早川＊▲ happier than anyone else!
That's just naive talk from some kid!
Naive talk from a kid is fine by me! She and ● are young, after all!
Mr. Swallow, take me away from here.
Yeah, got it. Let's go to the Land of Flowers together!
You okay？ Hold on tight so you don't fall.
Actually, I'm pretty good at racing games and flight simulators, you know.
Wait, are you the type whose personality changes behind the wheel？!
I'd better watch out when ▲小早川＊▲ gets her driver's license.
(It didn't feel real at first... but having a kid really is great...)
(A wife I love, and a cute kid... Life couldn't be better!)
You've really gotten the hang of soothing the baby.
Yeah, you were a lot shakier at it in the beginning.
Yeah, but once the baby was born, you suddenly became so dependable... Like a real grown woman, I guess.
Come on, I've been an adult for a long time now.
...Where'd that come from all of a sudden？
It's not all of a sudden... You've given me so many treasures.
Back in high school, when you became my boyfriend...
I never thought I could be any happier than that.
Yeah... And then, when we got married, I was surprised too.
We'd been together all that time already, so I figured getting married wouldn't really change anything.
...Our conversations, our daily life, all of it was the same as before.
My love for you was the one thing that kept growing bigger and bigger inside me.
Back then, I felt my happiness grow bigger... but now, it's different again.
It's not just the feeling of loving you like when it was only the two of us. It's something more...
When I look at our precious child, it makes me a gentler person. And that makes me happy, too.
A boyfriend, a husband, a baby... You gave them all to me.
All of my happiness is thanks to you. So, thank you.
● feel the same way, too... Thank you.
Good morning. I'm Chief ▲苗字▲ ▲名前▲, and I'll be training you. Nice to meet you.
I'm the new hire, Rinko Kobayakawa. I'll do my best, and I look forward to learning from you.
...You're so polite, Kobayakawa. It's refreshing. I have high hopes for you！
Oh, not at all... Thank you very much.
Right, right. Then let's get you started on your first task...
(I wonder if Kobayakawa is doing okay...)
Thank you for asking. Everything's fine.
I was... listening to this on my way in. I must have forgotten to stop it.
Well, alright then... Keep it put away during work.
Don't worry about it. Keep up the good work.
Kobayakawa, how's that chart I asked for coming along？ Don't tell me you're done？
Um... No, just a little longer. It's going smoothly, though.
Wow, impressive. Let's take a look...
U-um! I was just... doing some research! I was looking something up and ended up on this forum...
Hm... I see. Well then... Huh？ Fighting game guides？
...Hm？ Wait, something smells really good in here.
Oh... Aren't you just imagining things？
No, I definitely smell it... Right around here？
Don't "hehe" me. You think you'll last here acting like this on your first day？ Good grief...
Ugh, quit nagging already. Who do you think you are, Mr. Supervisor？
"Don't do this, don't do that." You're totally killing my motivation here.
Keep it up and I'll report you for harassment.
Director! Please help me! My supervisor, he... he was...
You fool! Start over from new-hire training! Kobayakawa, you're the supervisor from now on!
Huh...？ Thank goodness, it was a dream. That was awful...
Still, ▲小早川＊▲ in a suit speaking so politely wasn't bad at all...
(Is that sound coming from the desk？)
Go, go, TOWANO! Let's go, TOWANO!
(This time for sure, I'm asking Linda to prom...)
Whoops, my bad. Haven't introduced myself yet, have I？
The name's... ▲名前▲! I'm the quarterback for the football team at TOWANO CITY's prestigious Forever High.
Well, to be exact... yeah, I'm a benchwarmer who wants to be quarterback. You could put it that way too.
For a guy like me, Linda the cheerleader is way out of my league... But this time, I'm gonna ask her to prom for sure!
(All right, first I'll go talk to Linda...)
Oh... What's up？ Something on your mind？
Um... would you go with me...
Ah, nope! Nothing! Forget I said anything!
Hey, mind helping me with cheer practice？ If you do well, I'll grant you any favor you want.
Come on, you don't mind, right？ Repeat after me!
Thanks, that really helped me out.
Didn't you have a favor to ask me？
Don't give me the cold shoulder, honey.
You still don't have a prom date, right？ Hey, come on, go with me!
L-Linda's... going to prom with me! Back off!
Hehehe... What're you talking about, man？
Hold on, you don't stand a chance against one of the players!
Linda... Go to prom with me!
...Yeah... okay. Hehe, that was pretty cool...
Don't mess with Forever High's kicker!
Wait... Was it Linda, or Rinko...？
What are you spacing out for!
You don't even know your opponent's name... Pretty cocky, aren't you!
That was no light kick! That move was crazy!
That was forward on the stick plus light kick.
(Wait a sec... Fight back？ There's no way ● could lay a hand on my girlfriend!)
Then I'll come to you... Hah!
(In that case... I'll just run out the clock and force a draw!)
Grr, you're pretty good at running away.
Huff, huff... Looks like I might just pull this off...
...You think so？ Thanks to staying on the offensive, my gauge is full.
With a full gauge, it's all mine! Eat my special move!
Here I go! Rapid-fire light kicks~!
(It was so warm and soft... Felt really nice...)
(▲小早川＊▲... Sleeping with her guard totally down. And with her boyfriend right on top of her...)
(And hasn't ▲小早川＊▲ gotten way bigger somehow？)
Are you up already？ I'm still sleeping. Night...
(...I don't really get how this happened, but...)
(Could this actually be... my big chance!?)
(Alright, time for some payback for always yelling at me and kicking me...)
(Uh-oh, she's waking up... I need to put her back to sleep...)
(To get her back to sleep... Let's try rocking the hammock...)
Ahh, that was a good nap...
(No good, she's wide awake now. Guess the fun's over.)
Hehe, did you sleep well too？
I see, I see. You're just the cutest thing▼
(Whoa, she's pressing me right against her chest...)
What's the matter？ Does that make you happy？
I love you, I love you~ So cute~~▼
(Whoa, ow! Ow! That's a little too much love!)
Phew... Even once you're used to it, it's still hot.
(How long has it been since ● and ▲小早川＊▲ started living on this deserted island...？)
(● still can't give up hope of being rescued, whereas ▲小早川＊▲ has already gone full...)
It's Rinko! Hey, you! You back!
Yeah, I got fish and fruit!
This guy？ Rinko found him! He'll come in handy!
Chomp, chomp... Tasty! You guys eat too!
(Still, this guy's got a really annoying face...)
Wipe that sleazy look off your face... Get away from ▲小早川＊▲!
I knew it, Rinko needs you! You're Rinko's!
▲小早川＊▲... Yeah, I always believed in you.
Yeah. No matter where Rinko is, even stuck on this island with just us two...
▲主人公＊▲. I'm with you. You're Rinko's one and only partner!
That's why... Rinko's gonna eat you!
Yeah, totally... Wait, eat？ Eat me!？
You look way tastier than that hairy thing!
...You were just picking what to eat!？
Haa, haa, haa... A dream, huh...
I never thought my own girlfriend would try to eat me...
I think I'll pass on that kind of affection...
(I'm not losing to some monkey! I'll shake it with all I've got!)
